records.title: SWEpy: an open-source GPU-accelerated solver for near-field inundation and far-field tsunami modeling
records.reason: The publisher full text describes SWEpy, a GPU-accelerated shallow-water-equation solver for tsunami/flood simulation. Its speedups concern numerical hydrodynamic simulation rather than language-model inference or serving.

records.title: PRISM: A Geometric Risk Bound for Decomposing Drift into Scale, Shape, and Head
records.reason: PRISM estimates quality/risk drift in quantized, LoRA-adapted, and distilled LLM variants from a forward pass, including GPTQ evaluations. It is a model-variant audit/selection method rather than an inference-efficiency improvement; its quantization-family relation makes it a plausible but secondary systems-quality connection.

records.title: EHR-RAGp: Prototype-Guided Retrieval of Longitudinal Electronic Health Records for Clinical Prediction Models
records.reason: EHR-RAGp retrieves prototype-guided patient-history evidence for clinical prediction. The full text centers on longitudinal EHR representation and prediction quality; it is a clinical retrieval/prediction method, not LLM inference or serving optimization.

records.title: Learning Minimally Rigid Graphs with High Realization Counts
records.reason: This paper uses reinforcement learning to find minimally rigid graphs with many realizations. The mathematical graph-construction problem and evaluation are unrelated to LLM inference, serving, or model-runtime efficiency.
